title: Performance Note Payload
description: One row per performed MIDI note, with parallel-array columns, as in Vienna 4x22 match note(id, midi, onset, offset, velocity, channel, track) records. Used with the midi_interval extent: onset tick and duration in ticks.

channel.description: MIDI channel numbers (0-15); null when unavailable.

track.description: Nonnegative MIDI track numbers; null when unavailable.

anchor.description: Identifier of the note in its source document, e.g. a match-file note id such as 'n12'; null when unavailable.

match.description: The score_note.anchor of the matched score note, e.g. 'n238', or 'NOMATCH' for an inserted note. Free source strings; null when unavailable.
